in_marathi.name: Tirupati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Seven Hills
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tirupati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Tirupati refers to Lord Venkateswara, also known as Balaji or Govinda, who is believed to reside on the Seven Hills of Tirumala in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. The name Tirupati is derived from the words 'Tiru' meaning holy, and 'Pati' meaning lord, hence the name is translated to the 'Lord of Holy Lords'.

in_bengali.name: Tirupati

The name Tirupati is derived from the words 'Tiru' meaning holy, and 'Pati' meaning lord, hence the name is translated to the 'Lord of Holy Lords'.
